sprint: PR Review and Merge Governance Sprint

verification_steps.name: confirm_merge_state
verification_steps.description: Verify PR merged=true, state=closed, merge_commit_sha present via GitHub API

verification_steps.name: verify_default_branch_files
verification_steps.description: Verify all expected files present in main branch tree; no unexpected files

verification_steps.name: clean_clone_from_default_branch
verification_steps.description: Clone main branch into isolated tmpdir; dotnet restore+build+run for each example

verification_steps.name: write_release_evidence
verification_steps.description: Write {family}-post-merge-verification.json with merge SHA, build/run results

verification_steps.name: branch_cleanup_decision
verification_steps.description: Do NOT delete PR branch unless explicitly authorized by human

families_pending_merge.merge_command: PYTHONPATH=src GITHUB_TOKEN="$GH_TOKEN" .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m plugin_examples merge-pr --family words --pr-number 1 --merge --approval-token APPROVE_MERGE_PR --promote-latest
PYTHONPATH=src GITHUB_TOKEN="$GH_TOKEN" .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m plugin_examples merge-pr --family cells --pr-number 1 --merge --approval-token APPROVE_MERGE_PR --promote-latest

rollback_plan.trigger: post-merge clean-clone fails for any example
actions: Present options to human: revert commit / create fix PR / accept failure
rollback_plan.note: Do NOT automatically revert without human approval

live_merge_blocked_reason: Pending human APPROVE_MERGE_PR approval in a future sprint
